lines.trans: Excuse me! Would you like to come in for a cup of hot tea?
Wait... is that our violinist neighbour from house number ten?!
You know each other, Yaroslav Ilyich?!
Thirty years ago he brought his violin here every Friday at six!
Wait... in the guest book it says violin every Friday!

words.gram: short past passive participle, neuter singular

lines.trans: So he was the one who played duets with your aunt on Fridays!
He asked me who finally finished the second half of her May waltz!
And what did he say about my sixteen bars, Yaroslav Ilyich?
He had tears in his eyes. He said it sounds like her voice!
Did you invite him to our opening this Friday at six?!
He promised to bring his violin and ten neighbours from the street!
Ten more neighbours?! Zoya will need twice as many lemons by Friday!

examples.trans: Have hot tea with a roll for about ten minutes first!

examples.text: Садись за стол — у нас горячий чай и пятничный лимонный пирог.
examples.trans: Sit down at the table — we have hot tea and Friday lemon cake.

examples.text: А ваша чашка внутри? Она целая?
examples.trans: And your teacup inside? Is it whole?

examples.text: Вы оставили её у чашки на стойке внизу.
examples.trans: You left it beside the cup on the downstairs counter.

examples.text: Что он говорит? Почему ты хмуришься?
examples.trans: What is he saying? Why are you frowning?

examples.text: В золотой обёртке с верхней полки. А что?
examples.trans: In the gold wrapper from the top shelf. Why?

examples.text: Ярослав Ильич, можно я допишу шестнадцать тактов к пятнице?
examples.trans: Yaroslav Ilyich, may I write the missing sixteen bars by Friday?

examples.text: Моему сыну шестнадцать лет.
examples.trans: My son is sixteen years old.

examples.text: У меня в корзине лежат шесть жёлтых лимонов — моя кухня ждала этого дня!
examples.trans: Six yellow lemons are sitting in my basket — my kitchen was waiting for this day!

examples.text: Знаю ли я?! Шесть лет каждую пятницу я поднималась по той деревянной лестнице!
examples.trans: Do I know it?! For six years every Friday I climbed those wooden stairs!

examples.text: Логично! А это ключи?
examples.trans: Fair enough! And these are the keys?

examples.text: Во сколько открывается эта лавка?
examples.trans: What time does that shop open?

examples.text: Ждите меня — я уже бегу за дверь!
examples.trans: Wait for me — I am already running out the door!

examples.text: Я слышал крики про масло даже во дворе.
examples.trans: I heard shouting about butter even out in the courtyard.

examples.text: Вот чистая салфетка и холодная вода, Ярослав Ильич.
examples.trans: Here is a clean napkin and cold water, Yaroslav Ilyich.

examples.text: Ой, беда! Ярослав Ильич, Кира, у нас на кухне авария!
examples.trans: Oh, trouble! Yaroslav Ilyich, Kira, we have a kitchen emergency!
